messages.body:
On Sun, Dec 26, 2021, Suguna Sakkiah wrote:
>
>I successfully ran the serial test run. Then I changed my run_cmake file
>(-DCUDA=TRUE). When I try to run the make install after the ./run_cmake it
>shows the following error
I recognize that you have been very reluctant to share any infomation about
what compilers you are using, but without such information, I'm sure there
is much anyone on the list can do to help out.
It looks like your compilers are somewhere around version 4.8, and your CUDA
DSK is at version 11 or 12.  But I have to guess at lot here.
I'm cc-ing this to Ray Luo, who might know something more about this
particular error.
